title: GUVI: Minimum Platforms for Railway Station
description: Given arrival `arr` and departure `dep` times of trains that reach a railway station, find the minimum number of platforms needed so that no train is kept waiting.
constraints:
1 <= len(arr) == len(dep) <= 5 * 10^4
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
starter_code:
def min_platforms(arr: list[int], dep: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def min_platforms(arr: list[int], dep: list[int]) -> int:
    arr_sorted = sorted(arr)
    dep_sorted = sorted(dep)
    i = j = 0
    plat_needed = max_plat = 0
    n = len(arr)
    while i < n and j < n:
        if arr_sorted[i] <= dep_sorted[j]:
            plat_needed += 1
            max_plat = max(max_plat, plat_needed)
            i += 1
        else:
            plat_needed -= 1
            j += 1
    return max_plat
explanation: Sort arrival and departure events independently and simulate room occupancy with two pointers in O(N log N) time.
